licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, lease (DHCR ROC Client Handbook: a Valid Lease Agreement is a required renewal document for FZ-LLC natural person, FZ-LLC corporate and branch entities, CONFIRMED); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, lease (no minimum remaining period stated in the DHCR ROC Client Handbook); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.renewalWindow.value: The DHCR system sends an automatic Licence Renewal Notification 60 days before expiry. No explicit earliest or latest submission rule was found. The commercial licence is valid for one year and renewable annually.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, renewal window (DHCR ROC Client Handbook, CONFIRMED); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: A valid lease agreement; an NOC from the relevant external authority if applicable; for branches, a Good Standing Certificate of the parent or a valid UAE trade licence. Property management and hotel licences also need a Civil Defence 24/7 security certificate and Fire and Peril insurance. Establishment card: unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, renews together (DHCR ROC Client Handbook, CONFIRMED); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: If the commercial licence is not renewed, or the business is not operating, the authority will start licence cancellation and deregistration under the DHCR Regulations. No grace period or day threshold was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, late renewal (DHCR ROC Client Handbook, CONFIRMED); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, late renewal (no grace period found in any official source); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf

licence.afterExpiryThresholds.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai HealthCare City, late renewal (no day threshold after expiry found in any official source); https://www.dhcc.ae/gallery/DHCR%20ROC%20Client%20Handbook.pdf
